text_block_list.text:
Keeping an eye on her condition, we 
resumed training... and little by little, 
our daily routine returned on an early 
summer morning.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Please! I really do want to... join the 
summer training camp!
choice_data_list: ...I'd like to do that too, but—
...I'd like to do that too, but—

text_block_list.text:
If she takes on the severe heat of the 
training camp in her current condition... 
she might develop a fever again and be 
forced to take another long rest.
choice_data_list: You know that too, don't you?
You understand that as well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... even if I can only participate 
a little, imagine how much stronger I'll 
get!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to do everything I can, to the best 
of my ability...! Please!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“You're worried about my health, aren't 
you? I know that, too. That's why...”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I came up with an idea! A way to make it 
through the summer training camp without 
any trouble!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—All I need is for you to keep your eyes 
completely on me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“I have them keep a close eye on my 
condition and design a training regimen 
that doesn't push me past my limits.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? With this, you won't 
catch a fever!

I need to observe her condition more 
delicately than ever, gauge the optimal 
workload, and above all, make sure she 
doesn't carry over any fatigue.
choice_data_list:
(Can I really pull off... that kind of 
adjustment—)

(Can I really pull off... that kind of 
adjustment—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Please! If it's you... you can do it, 
right?

"...I don't want to push her too hard. 
However—anyone can just shut everything 
down. In that case..."
choice_data_list:
...All right. Let me take on the 
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you! Please overcome this 
together with me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The sun feels so close...! Looks like 
we're in for another scorching summer...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely won't push myself too hard! 
I'll consult you on every little thing, no 
matter how small."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What's important is thorough 
communication... That is the condition for 
joining the training camp. Isn't that 
right?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Feel free to report anything to me.
Yeah. Keep me posted on anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye-san really showed up. She 
truly is an amazing girl...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I haven't... changed at all... yet...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Where did I go wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—To be crowned with the Triple Tiara, and 
radiate a brilliance that rivals 
Orfe-san's.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I was patient, worked hard... and steadily 
produced results, or so I thought. And 
yet—

"And yet... with someone so far out of our 
league around..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Is there really nothing more I can do?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you shouldn't go talk to 
them? You've been keeping an eye on them 
this whole time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Your encouragement will surely become a 
wonderful source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...The weak are beneath my notice.

After finishing unpacking her luggage, I 
met up with Almond Eye again. Just as we 
were about to start an MTG regarding our 
plans going forward—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah! Before that...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: This is for you!

What Almond Eye handed me was hand cream. 
It has a soothing, soap-like scent...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I ended up hurting your precious hand, 
after all. So this is... an apology, I 
guess."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Back then, I really was—
choice_data_list:
Thank you! I'll do my best with sparkling 
clean hands!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, yeah. I'm counting on you!

—And so, our heated summer training camp 
began!
